name: pattern-waves
title: Pattern Waves
description: A full-screen field of tiny dots that rises and folds like fabric, with bright specular bands sliding over the crests. Moving the pointer sends ripples across the surface.
use: A hero or section wants a monochrome, textured backdrop that reads as fabric and responds to the pointer.
avoid: Dense dots and dark valleys are hard on low-resolution screens, and the WebGL loop needs a sized parent.
a11y: Decorative and aria-hidden; reduced motion freezes the waves and disables the cursor ripples. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Tiny white dots on black form a fine halftone screen that swells into diagonal folds, like cloth held up to a light. Bright ridges of denser dots catch the highlight while the valleys sink into darkness.
behaves: The folds drift and reshape continuously, sliding diagonal highlights across the dot field. Moving the pointer sends a ripple through the surface, and clicking bursts it outward.
customise: Preset, pattern, wave, spacing, mark size, depth, light, shine, contrast, speed, scale, direction, colours, opacity, fade, characters, cursor size and strength, intro and paused are props.
weight: heavy: A multi-pass WebGL shader draws a full-screen dot field with ripples every frame.
issues: Frame 1 catches the intro while the dot field is still nearly flat and dim.
polishWhy: Convincing silk-like dots and highlights; the intro frame is flat and the effect is subtle.
